subject: SAFE-NET pilot: request for 3-month trial extension + compute credits
messages:
From: Asha Kumalo <asha.kumalo@safenet.org.za>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: SAFE-NET pilot: short extension for tagging project?

Hi Monica,

Hope you are well — quick ask from our side. The annotation pilot (household damage tagging) that started on Oct 1 ran into two delays: a late data transfer from field teams and a local festival that shortened annotator availability. We are roughly 60% through the planned 6k images and the team needs another 3 months to finish the quality pass and final evals.

We are extremely pleased with Redwood's latency and the cost profile so far — the embeddings + reranker pipeline has been very helpful. Could we request a 3-month trial extension and an additional 75k free compute credits to finish the final sweep and present results to our funders in Feb? If there are any paperwork or SOC-related checks needed, please point us to the right contact and we'll get them sorted.

Attaching current SOW and a usage snapshot.

Best,
Asha Kumalo
Program Lead, SafeNet Initiative
asha.kumalo@safenet.org.za
+27 82 555 0198

Attachments: SAFE-NET-SOW.pdf (PDF), usage_snapshot_20281125.csv (CSV)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Grants & Credits <grants@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Fwd: SAFE-NET pilot: short extension for tagging project?

Team — forwarding a request from SafeNet (external). They want a 3-month extension + 75k free compute credits. They are a public-interest NGO working in disaster response and the work will be shared under an open-data license; funder demo in Feb is time-sensitive.

Can grants/credits review and let me know whether we can approve the extension and the credit top-up? If we need a contract amendment or additional paperwork (PI/ML metadata, data retention limits, SOC evidence), please list items and I'll loop SafeNet.

Key items from their SOW: final quality sweep for 6k images; expected token-equivalent usage ~50k embedding units + 25k gen tokens over 3 months. They already consumed ~40k compute credits from initial trial (snapshot attached).

Thanks — Monica

Monica / team,

Thanks for the context. I ran the numbers with the credits team — 75k compute credits is within the scope of our public-interest program but we usually split approvals between grants (one-off credit top-up) and legal procurement for contract amendments. Proposed approach:

- Approve a 50k credit grant now (no contract amendment) to cover the immediate finish.
- Approve an additional 25k conditional on receiving a signed SOW addendum (one-page amendment) and confirmation of the data sharing license (they mentioned open-data).

Action items:
- Marissa: can you provision 50k credits against deal SAFE-2028-PILOT-47 and update the billing tag?
- Tessa: Legal/Compliance: confirm whether SAFE-NET needs a SOC2 exec summary or if our standard public-interest checklist suffices. If SOC2 evidence is required, we should loop Legal and Procurement.

If they accept the split (50k now / 25k on SOW), I'll mark the deal as "credit-approved" in the CRM and schedule a short call with Asha to confirm timing.

Ben

Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Asha Kumalo <asha.kumalo@safenet.org.za>, Dr. Samuel Okoye <sam.okoye@relieflab.ng>, procurement@relieflab.ng
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Dec 2028 16:45:00 -05:00
Subject: SAFE-NET pilot: extension & credits — provisional approval and next steps

Hi Asha / Samuel,

Great to hear back from you and thanks for the detailed SOW. Quick update from Redwood: we can provisionally approve a 3-month extension and a 75k compute credit package on the following terms:

- 50,000 compute credits are provisioned immediately (billing tag: grants_SAFE_2028).
- Remaining 25,000 credits will be released on receipt of a signed one-page SOW addendum that includes: (1) clear data-sharing license (they indicated an open-data license; we need the specific license name), (2) data retention and anonymization plan, and (3) confirmation that no PII is being uploaded.
- If SOC2 evidence is requested by your internal funders, Redwood can provide a SOC2 summary report; full SOC2 reports require our legal NDA process and are limited.

Please confirm whether you can sign the SOW addendum this week (we can prepare a draft and share via DocuSign). Once we have the signature, we'll release the final 25k credits and update the CRM record.

If you prefer a short call to go over the steps, I can make time early next week.

Best regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0110

Attachments: credit_policy-summary.txt
